method.input: Airport reference points from retained public-domain OurAirports snapshot; bounds are explicitly proposed design selections.
method.rounding: Routes3decimals km, times2decimals minutes, extents2decimals km. This precision is calculation precision, not source positional accuracy.
method.speedMeaning: Illustrative groundspeed only, not certified aircraft cruise or combat performance; actual game aircraft physics, fuel endurance, era/load and wind control sortie viability.

dimensions.note: Geodesic edge-centre distances and full bounds area including ocean; not island dimensions or land area.

seaDistanceScaleComparison.meaning: Geographic-span arithmetic only; airports lie on land. A real game ship ETA must use a coastline-avoiding water-only route, draft/slope checks and loading/unloading time.

dimensions.note: Width is geodesic west/east edge-centre distance; height is geodesic north/south edge-centre distance. Area includes ocean. Bounds select real geography; not the entire island.

seaDistanceScaleComparison.meaning: Scale arithmetic using the stated geographic span only. Airport points are on land; this is not a ship route or a claimed actual port-to-port distance. A concrete sea ETA must later use an authored water-only route and add loading/unloading.

seaSpeedExamples.interpretation: Explicit game-design sea-leg examples, not measured routes between named actual ports. Valid coastline-avoiding routes, loading/unloading and manoeuvring add time. At20kn a60min round covers at most37.04km without those overheads; a200km leg takes≈324min.
